description:
The Monthly Notices' class, two columns by default, without usenatbib (owner decision O-MNRAS1). mnras.cls is not built on article and leaves out names that packages and General's LaTeX read. The preamble (b21, from GitHub run 41584963423) gives them without changing what the class prints: (1)  ibhang is cleared just before natbib or biblatex loads, since both 
ewlength{ ibhang} (natbib.sty l.637, biblatex.sty l.916) and mnras.cls already allocates it without usenatbib (l.1641-1644): 'Command  ibhang already defined' failed 5,614 mnras.A branches (585 documents hold it); (2) article's \if@titlepage, false, which abstract.sty (l.57, l.103) and titling.sty test while they load: 'Undefined control sequence', 'Extra \else', 'Extra  i', 3,230 branches; (3) article's \abstractname, \contentsname, \listfigurename, \listtablename and \appendixname, which abstract.sty, tocloft and General's appendix (titlesec) and contents lines read (891 branches); mnras's own headings stay its fixed ABSTRACT, CONTENTS and APPENDIX (l.1118, l.1273, l.760-775); (4) 	itle takes a paragraph, as the kernel's does (l.1188-1190 are not \long, and General's title is a \parbox ending in \par: 19 branches); (5) \cite and \shortcite are e-TeX \protected, with mnras's own bodies (l.1664-1666), so a citation in a heading or a mark is not expanded there ('\citename' undefined, 'Illegal parameter number': 32 branches); not \DeclareRobustCommand, which would redefine the kernel's inner \cite that mnras's \@internalcite calls (l.1664 lets it to the kernel's robust \cite), so that every citation would call itself without end; written '\cite {' so that the host's scan for citation commands (keepCitationCase) does not take the line for one; (6) at  egin{document}, when no package gave them (listings, caption and caption3 do), mnras's figure or table caption as \@makecaption and empty \abovecaptionskip and  elowcaptionskip: mnras sets \@makecaption only inside its own figure and table (l.1547-1571), so captions under floatrow, wrapfig, rotating, sidecap and threeparttable stopped (190 branches). (7) A placement after  egin{figure} or  egin{table} (and their starred forms) is read and dropped (b22, owner item 'mnras floats'): mnras's  igure and 	able call \@float{type} followed by a font command (mnras.cls l.1548-1550, l.1564-1566), so \@float's \@ifnextchar[ never sees a placement, the default tbp applies (l.1543, l.1559), and the placement the library and General write ([tbp], [H], [htbp]) was set as text at the top of the float, on the line of what follows it: in GitHub run 41584963423, 26 overfull boxes in 22 mnras.A cells are that text beside the float's \linewidth-wide content ('[htbp] []' 23.8pt, '[h] []' 11.3pt too wide), the only failure of 10 branches. MNRAS disables placement on purpose (MNRAS.md: '[htbp] are intentionally disabled'), so the class's tbp still applies; only the stray text goes. (8) The abstract is set where it stands, in mnras's own one-column form (b23, ERRORS ABS-INPLACE, in place of b22's O-JR1-1 line, which started a new page before each later abstract): in two columns mnras sets each abstract (and keywords) block as a page-top float box (\start@SFBbox, l.1162-1167;  inish@SFBbox, l.1168-1175 adds it to the page's \@dbltoplist through the kernel's \@addtodblcol), built to be used once on the first page, and the test documents hold 16 to 64 abstracts each. In GitHub run 41584963423 every box went to the same page and the documents stopped at 'You can't use \divide after \divide' in \@trylist, 'Missing number', 'Dimension too large' or an undefined \@currbox (F38 293, F48 125, F148-F155 8 branches); with b22's page per abstract, GitHub run r2-461ed0e still lost what floats in a box: a margin note, a figure or a note column in an abstract is set inside the box, so its float never reached the page ('Float(s) lost', 27 documents, 204 failing not-denied branches, e.g. d8e22f5a27b61a2282f54 l.660) or stopped at 'Not in outer par mode'. \abstract is now mnras's \@abstract and \endabstract its \endlist, the class's own branch for one column (l.1102-1110): the same { f ABSTRACT} heading and type, set in the column where the node stands, so its floats, notes and breakable boxes work and a long abstract breaks across columns; keywords stay page-top boxes. A test-setting choice for the test documents' many abstracts, not mnras's: MNRAS prints its abstract across both columns above the text. (9) 
ewblock, given just before natbib loads as mnras.cls defines it with usenatbib (l.1333-1334; b23, ERRORS MNRAS-NEWBLOCK): without usenatbib the class defines it only inside its own thebibliography (l.1326), and natbib's thebibliography enewcommand's it (natbib.sty l.1068-1073), so a document whose reference list goes through natbib (bib.natbib's citations and lists) stopped at 'Command 
ewblock undefined' at main.bbl's  egin{thebibliography} (GitHub run r2-461ed0e: 21 documents, 179 failing not-denied branches, e.g. d0f19cbee30b71fb4f591, l.1 of main.bbl). \providecommand leaves any other definition alone, and a document without natbib gets nothing.
